title: Run end-to-end validation stream test
description: Temporarily stop production producer/mirror services, run a manual validation producer flow under a separate DHT salt, verify a local mirror once-mode download over P2P, then restore production services.
acceptance_criteria: Validation artifact published under validation salt, local mirror once-mode completes successfully, temporary processes cleaned up, production services restarted
notes: Validation succeeded. Published 256 MiB synthetic artifact under salt=validation, ran local mirror once-mode with WEB_SEED_MODE=off, observed seq=1 discovery and full P2P download to seeding, then stopped temporary validation seeder and restored production mirror + systemd services.
close_reason: Completed isolated validation stream test successfully and restored production services.

Follow up issues can cover deeper discovery/transfer separation and DHT/session architecture cleanup.

close_reason: Implemented first refactor slice: validation fixture workflow, mirror web seed policy, env-driven compose config, expanded mirror state, docs/tests updated, and deployed to server.

title: Update GitHub Actions off Node 20
description: The main CI workflow still uses actions that GitHub warns are running on Node 20. Update the workflow to Node 24-ready action versions so the deprecation warnings go away before the runner cutoff dates.

title: Persist mirror snapshot metadata locally
description: Mirror and leecher runs should persist the resolved snapshot metadata to an up-to-date file on disk after synchronization so users can inspect authority pubkey, DHT signature, torrent info hash, and original snapshot filename without relying on logs.

title: Simplify AUTHORITY_PUBKEY doc snippets
description: Replace the IFS= read form in AUTHORITY_PUBKEY documentation snippets with the simpler shell slurp form, since the consuming code already strips whitespace and the file is expected to contain a single hex line.

title: Clean up AUTHORITY_PUBKEY file slurp snippets
description: Replace tr -d newline patterns in AUTHORITY_PUBKEY doc snippets and helper scripts with a cleaner shell read pattern that matches current env-var trimming behavior in the mirror.

title: Rename AUTHORITY_PUBKEY helper
description: Rename the root helper script to a clearer, more specific name and update the internal producer note that references it.

title: Add AUTHORITY_PUBKEY regenerate helper
description: Add a small producer-side script that derives the authority public key from DHT_PRIVATE_KEY and document the intended tee AUTHORITY_PUBKEY workflow in producer notes.

title: Refactor mirror runtime around single-snapshot reconciliation
description: The mirror runtime has accumulated torrent-client style control flow and leaked libtorrent mechanics. Refactor it into a single-snapshot replication model with separate discovery and transfer monitoring loops, a desired-vs-active reconciliation step, and a tighter LibtorrentSession boundary that eliminates public destructive alert draining while preserving current swarm/once behavior and mirror_state.json persistence.
close_reason: Refactor complete: reconcile.py, tightened libtorrent_session, rewritten watcher, dht_discovery uses narrow wait API, seeder updated. All 41 tests pass, lint clean, pushed to remote.

notes: Added docs/manual-e2e-validation.md capturing the successful validation-salt run with stop/create/publish/seed/local-once/cleanup/restore steps.
